title: Port the R.U.T.H agent suite from Vibe config to OpenGAP

resolvedDecisions.question: Which agent configs are in scope?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Full tree: ruth + ruth-codebase-scout + ruth-qmd-scout + sfl-docs-drafter + sfl-docs-editor + sfl-docs-ideational-judge + sfl-docs-interpersonal-judge + sfl-docs-textual-judge, plus the dormant sfl-docs-workflow restored from its .toml.bak/.md.bak

resolvedDecisions.question: Which skills get ported?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Only the 6 real ruth-listed skills: doc-style, update-docs, ruth-voice, qmd, sfl-technical-writing, sift-graph. sfl-metafunction-annotation is NOT ported (judges run on prompts alone). The 3 empty/missing skills (documentation, readme-generator, code-insights-reports) are dropped. update-docs (25,852 chars) stays intact despite exceeding the ~20,000-char OpenGAP guidance.

resolvedDecisions.question: How do system prompts map to OpenGAP?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Decompose by function: ruth.md persona -> SOUL.md, hard rules/HTIL mandates -> RULES.md, SFL debate orchestration -> workflows/sfl-docs-debate.md; each leaf's short prompt becomes that sub-agent's SOUL.md

resolvedDecisions.question: How are safety/permission semantics reproduced?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Full idiomatic mapping: pre_tool_use hooks with fail_open:false scripts enforce allowlists, tools/*.yaml carry side-effect classes, compliance.supervision expresses HTIL (human_in_the_loop conditional, escalation triggers), DUTIES.md encodes the maker/checker/auditor segregation (drafter=maker, judges=checkers, editor=executor, ruth=orchestrator)

resolvedDecisions.question: How are Plannotator review gates preserved?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Tool + workflow + rule: tools/plannotator.yaml (approval-required, state-changing), mandatory gate step in workflows/sfl-docs-debate.md, 'no finalize without gate' in RULES.md, graceful degradation (missing CLI -> escalate to human)

resolvedDecisions.question: How are external service dependencies declared?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Declare only codebase-memory-mcp in mcp_servers (stdio, command path via ${VAR} interpolation); qmd and plannotator documented as shell-CLI dependencies; web-search recorded as a known portability gap

resolvedDecisions.question: Where does the ported tree live?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Repo root IS the ruth agent: fill the OpenGAP scaffold at ruth-agent-workflow/ root, replacing placeholder SOUL.md/RULES.md/DUTIES.md/agent.yaml, example-skill, and generic compliance artifacts

resolvedDecisions.question: Model and runtime settings?
resolvedDecisions.answer: Keep glm5-3 preferred / mistral-medium-latest fallback / temperature 0.1; raise runtime to max_turns 100, timeout 600

resolvedDecisions.question: Delegation mode? (resolved by inspection)
resolvedDecisions.answer: delegation.mode: explicit — ruth spawns a fixed orchestration procedure, not a router

resolvedDecisions.question: Done condition?
resolvedDecisions.answer: opengap validate -d . exits clean with zero errors; documentation (parity map etc.) is nice-to-have, not required
